title: Copyright Protection & Data Plagiarism
description: I study copyright protection and data plagiarism as fundamental challenges in neural networks and generative AI. My research asks how data ownership can be protected and verified when models learn from, transform, and reproduce data, connecting the use of training data with the ownership of generated content.

title: Law & Physics Compliance
description: I study how neural networks can comply with laws, domain rules, and physical constraints. My research connects these requirements with learning, reasoning, and decision-making, using physical scenarios and simulation to study whether model behavior remains compliant in context.

title: Efficient & Lifelong Learning
description: I study how neural networks can learn efficiently and continue adapting over time. This direction connects learning under limited data and computation with the long-term challenge of acquiring new knowledge while preserving existing capabilities.
